name: Blueprnt
tagline: Local-First Desktop Media Application & High-Throughput Asset Ingestion Workstage
description: Blueprnt is a professional, high-performance, local-first desktop media application engineered for photographers, Digital Imaging Technicians (DITs), video editors, and media catalog managers. Blueprnt provides a zero-cloud, 100% offline desktop toolkit for high-throughput digital asset ingestion, cryptographic BLAKE3 checksum verification, multi-drive 3-2-1 backups, EXIF token batch renaming, temporal burst deduplication, cinema proxy transcoding, and deep EXIF/IPTC privacy scrubbing.

whyUseful.title: Zero Bit-Rot & Zero Data Loss Guarantee
whyUseful.description: Executes real-time BLAKE3 bit-by-bit binary checksum verification during file transfers to guarantee 100% cryptographic data integrity before clearing camera cards.

whyUseful.title: Atomic Shot-Group Preservation
whyUseful.description: Binds paired camera assets (RAW + JPEG + HEIC + MOV + sidecar XMP + WAV + AAE) as unified logical units. Modifying or renaming a RAW file automatically updates all linked sidecars simultaneously.

whyUseful.title: Persistent Studio Defaults
whyUseful.description: Configure primary editing SSDs, secondary 3-2-1 backup drives, cloud sync folders, IPTC studio creator tags, renaming patterns, and proxy codecs once in Settings to auto-inherit across all modules.

whyUseful.title: Sub-Millisecond Catalog Scalability
whyUseful.description: Embedded local database indexes 100,000+ digital assets with sub-millisecond query performance and complete offline privacy.

useCases.title: Wedding & High-Volume Event Photography
useCases.description: Ingest thousands of photos across multiple memory cards simultaneously, auto-group paired RAW+JPG files, and apply student/client CSV roster mappings.

useCases.title: Cinema & Commercial On-Set DIT Workstage
useCases.description: Offload cinema cards with BLAKE3 validation, mirror to secondary backup SSDs, and generate lightweight Apple ProRes 422 or Avid DNxHR proxies for instant editing.

useCases.title: Sports & Burst Action Deduplication
useCases.description: Filter byte-for-byte duplicate captures and high-speed motor drive burst frames using 2-tier BLAKE3 and perceptual hash scanning.

useCases.title: Client Delivery & Metadata Privacy Sanitation
useCases.description: Strip camera body serials, lens serials, binary MakerNotes, and GPS location coordinates before exporting client delivery folders.

targetAudience: Digital Imaging Technicians (DITs): Requiring fast, verified card offloading and proxy generation on set.
Professional Event & Wedding Photographers: Managing massive paired RAW/JPG catalogs and CSV client rosters.
Commercial Filmmakers & Editors: Needing standardized ProRes/DNxHR proxies with preserved SMPTE timecode.
School & Sports Portrait Studios: Mapping sequential photo ranges to student names and IDs automatically.

coreEngineArchitecture.title: Universal Offline Format Support
coreEngineArchitecture.description: Natively reads and handles Canon CR2 and CR3, Nikon NEF, Sony ARW, Apple HEIC/HEIF, standard JPEG, TIFF, and PNG entirely on the local file system without third-party network APIs.

coreEngineArchitecture.title: Instant Embedded Preview Extraction
coreEngineArchitecture.description: Bypasses full-frame RAW sensor array decoding by seeking directly to container offsets (TIFF IFD tags and ISOBMFF boxes) to extract embedded 1080p JPEG preview streams in sub-15ms windows.

coreEngineArchitecture.title: Indivisible Shot-Group Locking
coreEngineArchitecture.description: Automatically detects and clusters multi-format capture files sharing a stem—treating RAW, JPG, HEIC, MOV, WAV voice memos, and sidecar XMP files as a single logical exposure unit across all pipeline stages.

coreEngineArchitecture.title: High-Throughput Parallel Processing
coreEngineArchitecture.description: Built with a high-performance native engine, utilizing multi-threaded directory walking via jwalk and data stream parallelism via rayon to handle shoots spanning 10,000+ files without UI lag.

coreEngineArchitecture.title: Hardware-Accelerated Cryptographic Hashing
coreEngineArchitecture.description: Uses SIMD-accelerated BLAKE3 hashing for fast partial and full bitstream verifications.

basicFeatures.title: Visual Storage Inventory Map
basicFeatures.description: Provides an interactive radial SVG sunburst visualizer breaking down project storage footprint into clear categories, including RAW, HEIC, standard JPEG, 4K video, and sidecar files.

basicFeatures.title: Exact Duplicate Detection
basicFeatures.description: Executes an exact duplicate finder using byte-size filters and partial-to-full cryptographic checksums to locate byte-for-byte identical assets.

basicFeatures.title: Basic Rule-Based Bulk Renamer
basicFeatures.description: Standard batch renaming supporting basic string replacement, prefixes, suffixes, and regex patterns with real-time target previews, capped at 100 files per batch.

basicFeatures.title: Non-Destructive Deletion Alternatives
basicFeatures.description: Moves unneeded files to the native operating system trash or a staging area instead of performing permanent file erasure.

basicFeatures.title: Basic EXIF & Location Viewer
basicFeatures.description: Displays a basic metadata readout, highlighting whether an asset exposes private GPS coordinates.

basicFeatures.title: One-Click Clean Directory Export
basicFeatures.description: Provides a quick-action wipe that strips metadata into an isolated _Clean destination folder, capped at 50 file scrubs per day.

premiumFeatures.title: Renamer Pro with EXIF Token Engine
premiumFeatures.description: Allows custom token chains including {Date:YYYY-MM-DD}, {Time:HHmmss}, {Model}, {Lens}, {ISO}, and padded {Sequence:0001}.

premiumFeatures.title: Atomic Sidecar Renaming
premiumFeatures.description: Keeps companion RAW, JPG, HEIC, MOV, and XMP files locked together, applying identical stem mutations across all paired assets in a single pass without breaking Lightroom catalog paths.

premiumFeatures.title: Pre-Flight Collision Detection
premiumFeatures.description: Continuously evaluates projected filenames in memory against target directories, disabling execution and displaying warning banners if name conflicts exist.

premiumFeatures.title: Preset Chains
premiumFeatures.description: Supports unlimited, loadable renaming presets tailored for distinct delivery workflows, such as Wedding Delivery and Real Estate MLS pipelines.

premiumFeatures.title: Duplicate Pro (Temporal Burst Clustering)
premiumFeatures.description: Identifies near-burst duplicates by grouping shots sharing a camera model taken within a configurable capture-time delta (0.5s to 5.0s).

premiumFeatures.title: Smart-Keep Heuristics
premiumFeatures.description: Automatically flags the highest-resolution frame or largest file in a burst sequence as the recommended keeper while marking redundant shots for staging.

premiumFeatures.title: Quarantine Vault
premiumFeatures.description: Safely moves duplicate clusters into an isolated _Quarantine project folder while strictly preserving the original nested subfolder tree.

premiumFeatures.title: Scrubber Pro (Deep Sanitation & Strip-Then-Add)
premiumFeatures.description: Permanently purges GPS IFD tags, camera serial numbers, lens serial numbers, proprietary MakerNotes, and embedded thumbnail caches from media and XMP sidecars.

premiumFeatures.title: Clean IPTC/XMP Metadata Injection
premiumFeatures.description: Injects studio-branded metadata templates immediately after sanitation, embedding Creator Name, Copyright Notice, License Terms, and Studio Website URL.

premiumFeatures.title: Before/After Map Proof Inspector
premiumFeatures.description: Displays an interactive comparison confirming the eradication of GPS coordinates, accompanied by red/green status badges for all stripped and injected fields.

premiumFeatures.title: Studio Cross-Drive Scanning
premiumFeatures.description: Enables scanning and deduplicating assets distributed across multiple connected external SSDs or memory card mounts.

premiumFeatures.title: CSV Roster Mapping
premiumFeatures.description: Imports client portrait roster CSV files to match sequence number ranges directly to client or property names.

enterpriseSafetyDataIntegrity.title: Persistent Local Undo Journal
enterpriseSafetyDataIntegrity.description: Logs every batch rename, quarantine, and scrub into a local database running in WAL mode, ensuring 1-click reversibility across app restarts.

enterpriseSafetyDataIntegrity.title: Two-Stage Temporary File Replacement
enterpriseSafetyDataIntegrity.description: Writes scrubbed and renamed binaries to .tmp_blueprnt intermediate paths before atomic replacement, protecting files against mid-flight system crashes or power losses.

enterpriseSafetyDataIntegrity.title: Offline Ed25519 Cryptographic Licensing
enterpriseSafetyDataIntegrity.description: Validates LemonSqueezy license tiers via local public-key cryptography cached in OS credential vaults, running fully offline with zero telemetry or network tracking.

detailedFeatures.title: Persistent System Settings & Studio Defaults
detailedFeatures.description: The full-featured Settings Chapter allows studio managers to define global defaults once for all ingest pipelines, renaming rules, metadata attribution, and proxy presets.
detailedFeatures.details: Destination Folders, 3-2-1 Backup Drives, Cloud Sync Folders, Bit-by-Bit BLAKE3 Validation, and IPTC Creator Attribution & Copyright auto-inherit across every operational module.

detailedFeatures.title: Token Pattern Builder & CSV Client Roster Engine
detailedFeatures.description: Allows drag-and-drop construction of dynamic renaming templates ({Date}, {Model}, {Sequence}) and CSV roster range synchronization with real-time bi-directional preview updating.
detailedFeatures.details: Supports tokens like {Date:YYYY-MM-DD}, {Model}, {Lens}, {Sequence:03}, and maps CSV roster records (MLS#, Student ID, Client Name) to image ranges effortlessly.

detailedFeatures.title: Video Transcoder & Editing Proxies Studio
detailedFeatures.description: Generates studio-grade Apple ProRes 422 (Proxy/LT/HQ) and Avid DNxHR (LB/SQ) proxies with resolution scaling, native framerate matching, stereo downmixing, and timecode preservation.
detailedFeatures.details: Supports 1080p Full HD, 720p HD, 50%, and 25% downscaling. Preserves SMPTE timecode and Reel ID across all batch converted cinema footage.

detailedFeatures.title: Media Indexer & Real-Time Infographics Dashboard
detailedFeatures.description: Scans cards and drives recursively, providing visual color breakdowns for stills, RAW negatives, Live Photos, cinema video clips, and formatted payload size.
detailedFeatures.details: BLAKE3 verified ingestion workspace displays index breakdowns across 100,000+ items with sub-millisecond local database queries.

installation.macOS: Download Blueprnt_1.5.0_aarch64.dmg. Drag Blueprnt into /Applications folder.

userGuide.title: Media Indexing & Transfer
userGuide.action: Select source drive -> Click 'Scan & Index Source Media' -> Review Infographics -> Click 'Transfer Media' for BLAKE3 verified ingest.

userGuide.title: Deduplication & Quarantine
userGuide.action: Open 'Deduplication' tab -> Scan for BLAKE3 byte duplicates or near-burst frames -> Move redundant files to Quarantine Vault.

userGuide.title: Organizing & Token Renaming
userGuide.action: Open Settings -> Configure token string or upload CSV roster -> Navigate to 'Organize & Rename' tab -> Review collision-free live preview -> Execute renaming.

userGuide.title: Video Proxy Transcoding
userGuide.action: Open Settings -> Select target proxy codec (Apple ProRes 422 Proxy) -> Open 'Transcoder & Proxies' tab -> Click 'Batch Transcode Video Clips'.

faq.question: What is Blueprnt and what makes it local-first?
faq.answer: Blueprnt is a desktop media application engineered for zero-cloud asset management. It runs 100% offline directly on your workstation without uploading media, telemetry, or metadata to external cloud servers.

faq.question: How does Blueprnt achieve instant sub-15ms embedded preview extraction?
faq.answer: Blueprnt seeks directly to TIFF IFD tags and ISOBMFF container boxes without decoding full-frame RAW sensor array data, extracting embedded 1080p JPEG previews instantaneously across Canon CR2/CR3, Nikon NEF, Sony ARW, Apple HEIC, and TIFF files.

faq.question: How does BLAKE3 checksum verification prevent bit-rot during transfers?
faq.answer: Blueprnt executes real-time bit-by-bit binary checksum verification using the BLAKE3 cryptographic algorithm during file ingestion. Before any memory card is cleared, Blueprnt verifies that every bit on the target drive exactly matches the source.

faq.question: What protection does the Persistent Local Undo Journal and Two-Stage Replacement offer?
faq.answer: Every batch rename, quarantine, and scrub is logged into a local database running in WAL mode for 1-click reversibility across app restarts. Scrubbed/renamed binaries are written to intermediate .tmp_blueprnt files before atomic replacement to prevent data loss from mid-flight power cuts.

faq.question: What is Indivisible Shot-Group Locking & Atomic Sidecar Renaming?
faq.answer: Indivisible Shot-Group Locking automatically binds paired camera captures (RAW + JPEG + HEIC + MOV + sidecar XMP + WAV + AAE) into unified logical units. When renaming or modifying a stem, Blueprnt mutates all linked sidecars simultaneously in a single pass without breaking Lightroom catalog paths.

faq.question: How does Duplicate Pro (Temporal Burst Clustering) work?
faq.answer: Duplicate Pro identifies near-burst duplicates by grouping shots sharing a camera model taken within a configurable capture-time delta (0.5s to 5.0s). Smart-Keep heuristics automatically flag the highest-resolution or largest frame as the keeper, moving redundant shots to the Quarantine Vault.

faq.question: Can Blueprnt transcode video proxies for Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve?
faq.answer: Yes. Blueprnt includes a dedicated Video Transcoder Studio capable of generating studio-grade Apple ProRes 422 (Proxy, LT, HQ) and Avid DNxHR (LB, SQ) proxies. It preserves native SMPTE timecode, Reel ID, and 48kHz stereo audio downmixing for seamless NLE editing.

faq.question: How does Renamer Pro with EXIF Tokens & CSV Client Roster mapping work?
faq.answer: Renamer Pro allows custom token chains like {Date:YYYY-MM-DD}, {Model}, {Lens}, {ISO}, and {Sequence:0001}. Additionally, uploading a CSV roster maps student IDs, client names, or property listings directly to photo sequence ranges with real-time pre-flight collision detection.

faq.question: How does Scrubber Pro clean exported client delivery folders?
faq.answer: Scrubber Pro permanently purges sensitive metadata (GPS IFD tags, camera/lens serial numbers, proprietary MakerNotes, thumbnail caches) from media and XMP sidecars, then injects studio-branded IPTC/XMP templates (Creator Name, Copyright, License Terms) with a Before/After Map Proof Inspector.

faq.question: Which operating systems are supported?
faq.answer: Blueprnt is available for macOS (Apple Silicon .dmg & Universal .dmg), Windows 10/11 (.exe NSIS installer & .msi), and Linux (.AppImage & .deb).
